exposure: induction of labor at <40 weeks gestation
induction of labor at 38 weeks vs. expectant management
induction of labor at 39 weeks vs. expectant management
cohort: Women in Ontario, Canada, with diagnosed gestational diabetes mellitus who had a singleton hospital birth at >=38 + 0 weeks of gestation between April 2012 and March 2014.
finding: In women with gestational diabetes mellitus, the routine induction of labor at 38 or 39 weeks is associated with a lower risk of cesarean delivery compared with expectant management but may increase the risk of neonatal intensive care unit admission when done at <39 weeks of gestation.
